paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: : Ablation studies on n-best candidates generations (Beam search and Sampling search) on valid set of WMT15 De-En.
model_annotation: The plot illustrates the BLEU scores achieved by three different methods on the validation set of WMT15 De-En, as a function of Average Lagging (AL), which ranges from approximately 2.5 to 12.5 on a linear scale. The x-axis is labeled "Average Lagging (AL)" and has tick marks at intervals of 2.5, while the y-axis is labeled "BLEU" and ranges from 24 to 31, also on a linear scale, with tick marks at intervals of 1. Three lines are plotted: a blue dashed line with circle markers representing "Inconsistency-CE", an orange dashed line with triangle markers for "Consistency-Bi + sampling", and a green dashed line with square markers for "Consistency-Bi + beam". The blue line starts at approximately BLEU 24 at AL=2.5 and increases steadily to around BLEU 30 at AL=12.5. The orange line begins at about BLEU 27.5 at AL=2.5 and rises to approximately BLEU 30.5 at AL=12.5, with a slight plateau near AL=10. The green line starts at around BLEU 27.2 at AL=2.5 and increases to approximately BLEU 30.8 at AL=12.5, showing a similar trend to the orange line but consistently slightly higher. All three lines show an increasing trend in BLEU score as Average Lagging increases, with the green line achieving the highest scores across all AL values.
